cohort: Pregnant women with cephalic presentations who delivered via spontaneous vaginal delivery or lower segment caesarian section and had meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: Meconium aspiration syndrome was found in 9.6% of the cohort and was associated with gestational age >36 weeks, weight <=3kg, female sex, spontaneous vaginal delivery, and grade II or III meconium staining.
mod_finding: Meconium aspiration syndrome was 83% higher among patients with spontaneous vaginal delivery compared to lower segment caesarian section.
